Subject: Staircase billing: 'sweep-first' invoice windows and VAT evidence tracker

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a lightweight proposal for how Redwood can handle the annual prepay/committed spend for Finovate, with the following goals:

- Keep predictable cashflow for you (monthly stair-step withdrawals)
- Minimize VAT friction across UK/EU/US entities via 'sweep-first' invoice windows (invoice is issued at start of window, usage withdraws against that bucket)
- Maintain audit trail and evidence for each country to satisfy your tax team

Attached: Finovate_PO_78942.pdf (your PO), VAT_forms_UK.xlsx (simple evidence template), and invoice-window-proposal.csv (proposed monthly windows and amounts).

High-level proposal:
1) We issue a master annual invoice on the prepay activation date for the committed amount, then create 12 internal invoice windows (monthly).
2) Each window is labelled 'sweep-first' — funds are earmarked, and the ledger shows a withdrawal when usage happens within the month.
3) For VAT: for UK/EU taxable entities we will attach the VAT evidence row (company VAT number, invoice reference, country of supply) to the monthly withdrawal record.

Questions for you / next steps:
- Can you confirm which legal entity will accept the master invoice (Finovate Labs Ltd vs Finovate Labs, Inc)?
- Confirm bank remit and preferred invoice remit-to email for AP (copy finance_ops@finovatelabs.com if different).
- If your tax team needs a different evidence format, we can accept their spreadsheet and map fields.

If useful, we can also split the master into quarterly partial invoices (two stair-step levels per quarter) — that reduces one-off VAT shock for some entities.

Happy to hop back on a 30-min call next week to finalize.

Regards,

Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Thanks for pulling this together and for the clear attachments. A few items from our side:

1) Entity: The master invoice should be issued to Finovate Labs, Inc (US parent). Our UK subsidiary will be billed via internal bookkeeping entries and will require VAT evidence for local reclaim.

2) AP contact: finance_ops@finovatelabs.com (cc'd) is the correct remit — they prefer a single PDF per month for invoice + supporting evidence.

3) VAT evidence: our tax lead (cc'd on a separate thread) asked whether you can include a single CSV per window that lists (invoice_ref, vat_number, country, net_amount, vat_amount). That reduces manual rekeying.

4) PO: confirming PO 78942 covers the committed spend start date of June 1st. We need the first window to align to calendar months (June 1–30).

Couple of follow-ups: what does 'sweep-first' look like on your ledger exports? Also can you indicate the remit bank details that will appear on the invoice for our treasury to set up?

If you can send an updated CSV mapping and the bank remit we'll route to AP for approval this week.

Thanks,
Samir
